scope: Prospective local development and developer-synthetic experiments only; existing saved reports are retrospective and are not preregistered by this registry.

asr.definition: Sum of normalized word substitutions, deletions and insertions divided by all predeclared reference words. Failed cases retain full-reference deletions under their frozen scoring protocol.

verification.definition: Critical errors not blocked divided by all predeclared critical-error cases. Report abstentions, failed/malformed/incomplete checks separately; never label them supported.

ux.definition: Independently observed active correction seconds per completed paired case, with failures/missing arms retained. Browser wall time and scripted actions cannot supply an observed clinician value.

failure_policy: Missing cases, exhausted wall budget, excessive failures, insufficient successful pairs or unresolved paired intervals are inconclusive, never a pass.
